summary: Investigated whether the 'Delete thread' confirm modal triggers the full journal update when invoked via the right-click context menu. Traced both UI entry points through SessionActions.confirmDelete → store.deleteSession → SessionCapability.deleteSession, and then server-side through session-operations.deleteSession → pool.remove → evict → session.dispose. The journal extension (memory-journal.ts) records on session_shutdown, turn_end thresholds, compaction, and before_tree events, but the transcript ends before confirming whether dispose() fires session_shutdown, so the answer remains unverified.
